title: Zamparini's wheat field where a spaceship landed

tellings.quote: me a field. He had this wheat field, you see, where a spaceship had landed on several occasions.

plain: An Italian named Maurizio Zamparini had a wheat field where a spaceship landed on several occasions, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, a guest who says he was himself taken by aliens in 1997 and who repeats what Zamparini told and showed him in the late 1990s. Xenov tells Michels the landings were recorded on golden plates bearing imprints of the craft and in photographs taken by scientists.
